decisions.reason: Crew and corporate travel management is a close operational extension of the firm's core maritime support services, so despite weaker later website visibility it remains commercially useful and easy to bundle with existing customer relationships.

The online vessel information portal fits the firm's stated strategic focus on broader, higher-quality and more transparent vessel support, so it is likely to be retained even if integrated more quietly into the service offering.

The mobile vessel performance app is adjacent but less central than the portal or core management services, and in a large service-led maritime firm it is the most likely product to be discontinued or absorbed into another digital offering.
